anomalies.message: CPU load averages (7.19, 8.1, 10.18) are high, especially the 15-minute average of 10.18, which exceeds the number of cores (8).
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, indicating potential issues with AI functionality or configuration.
Trading metrics show no active trades or profit/loss activity, which is unusual for a trading platform.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system performance.
Review and potentially restart AI components to ensure they are functioning and generating insights as expected.
Evaluate trading strategies and system configuration to ensure trades are being executed as expected.

recommendations.action: Immediately investigate high CPU load to identify and mitigate processes causing excessive usage.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, affecting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Conduct a thorough review of the AI system to diagnose and resolve issues preventing learning cycles and opportunity generation.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity suggests potential malfunctions, which could lead to missed trading opportunities and reduced platform effectiveness.

recommendations.action: Assess trading strategies and platform configuration to ensure they are correctly set up and capable of executing trades.
